1981-2415-6797-7286.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

1308-2557-4365-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4772-7839-7926.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
4772-7839-7926.description:
Activate Slag Strider by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7825.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

1636-2681-5475-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4284-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4284-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4284-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

338-475-3263-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-475-3263-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3363-5078-7692.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

2724-6432-7638.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Mind Stone. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2292-4419--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

1624-2928-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1170-2642-4050-7521.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Honorbound Page // Forum's Favor, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2685-3197-4321-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3197-4321-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1417-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

539-1669-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3480-3892.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3480-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods

5478-5702-5954-6753.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-2557-4289-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

539-2244-4803-4927.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-4927.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

804-2099-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
804-2099-5365.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima the Impostor's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.
804-2099-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

3603-4823-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Timeless Witness
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Timeless Witness
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

501-586-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

232-1770-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat.

1117-1913-2034-3689.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1991-2011-4050.notablePrerequisites: Tana has power five or greater, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1991-2011-4050.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tana.
Tana triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Tana has power six or greater and/or a Warrior you control can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

2019-2292-2773-2906.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Rakdos.
2019-2292-2773-2906.description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Warstorm Surges triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to command zone.
Resolve the Viscera Seer's ability, scrying one.
Repeat.
